contracts: (The A17 artifact assertions pass without claiming that a drill was executed; its companion runtime capability checks call the real validator. Q2 freezes declared tests/helpers before formal RED; implementation changes only declared production owners. No missing entrypoint is converted into causal RED. Applicable predecessor regression passes, followed by one current whole-plan terminal validation across all four authored modules. Targeted commands have a 300-second limit and terminal validation a 600-second limit; timeout is harness failure. Preserve existing ADR-0041/ADR-0058 execution boundaries and ADR-0061 isolation, historical evidence and independent acceptance ownership. Do not modify shared runtime/evidence writers, knowledge publication, Skill-input authority, routing policy or Codex entrypoints, and do not fabricate approval or drill receipts.) AND (The A25 artifact assertion passes against the handoff table, confirming all five Skill entries and every specified handoff and scope boundary.) AND (The A25 migration test and whole-plan terminal validation observe one complete handoff table with five accepted CLI rows and all required boundary statements.) AND (The full migration acceptance records all three required coverage assertions and rejects Markdown-only acceptance.) AND (本约束的独立 artifact/boundary 断言通过，完整候选变更集没有推广工具链错误分类或越过生产写边界。Q2 仅编写声明的测试与辅助文件，正式验证前冻结；实现阶段仅修改声明的生产所有者，生产文件不得成为执行快照。缺少首个真实入口时遵循现有协议报告阻塞，不伪造入口或将导入失败视为 RED。Q6 保持非空的适用回归集；全部既定测试和产品行为就绪后，Q8 以 600 秒上限执行冻结来源规定的四模块全计划终验。目标命令上限为 300 秒，超时属于 harness failure。保留失败证据，禁止改写历史报告、扩大工具权限、增加错误账本或第二证据系统；ADR-0041/0058/0061 的既有边界保持有效，不将拟议 ADR 或缺少人工批准当作产品 RED。)
